title: MnTe altermagnet: anomalous Hall conductivity under hole doping

decision_points.fork: k-mesh convergence of sigma_xy: Berry-curvature hot spots where the SOC-split top valence bands nearly touch make coarse meshes noisy (spikes, spurious sign changes); which mesh and smearing are converged
decision_points.wrong_choice: Stop at a 100, 150 or 200 mesh (1-3 units) with 1 meV smearing
decision_points.consequence: sign changes 8 (100) or 3 (150) instead of 1; sigma_xy(2e21) -171.5 (100) or -68.4 (200) instead of -48.3 S/cm

decision_points.fork: Where the valence-band maximum is: off the high-symmetry lines (k_frac ~ (0.02, 0, 0.42)), above the band-path maximum and the maximum on the DFT scf grid
decision_points.wrong_choice: VBM from the band path (as in bands_ori.dat) or from the DFT 6x6x8 eigenvalues
decision_points.consequence: hole density 0.30 eV below the VBM 1.42e+21 or 1.49e+21 instead of 1.31e+21 cm^-3

decision_points.fork: Energy reference: the VASP E-fermi (6.2098 eV, OUTCAR) lies in the gap 78 meV above the VBM; wt.in E_FERMI (6.1301 eV) is the authors' zero, close to the VBM
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take the OUTCAR Fermi energy as the band edge
decision_points.consequence: hole density 0.30 eV below the 'edge' 7.36e+20 instead of 1.31e+21 cm^-3

decision_points.fork: Counting holes in spinor bands: each of the 32 Wannier bands holds one electron per k-point
decision_points.wrong_choice: Multiply by a spin degeneracy of 2
decision_points.consequence: densities doubled; sigma_xy read at half the requested density (2.0e21: -70.1, 6.0e21: -77.0 S/cm instead of 2.0e21: -48.3, 6.0e21: 108.5)

decision_points.fork: Whether the nonzero sigma_yz and sigma_zx of the archived (unsymmetrized) Hamiltonian are physical: the authors symmetrized it with WannSymm before WannierTools; C2z forbids both

Magnetic symmetry from the structure and moments versus the archived symmetries.dat, whose matrices (sixfold, threefold, C2z without c/2) are not symmetries of the structure and contradict the labels in wannsymm.out; and the Neel-along-x case (unitary C2x and C2y t(c/2))
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use symmetries.dat as written (C3 T kills sigma_xy), or treat in-plane Neel directions as equivalent
decision_points.consequence: allowed components [] for Neel along y, or ["xy"] for Neel along x

decision_points.fork: Whether the Wannier model describes the conduction bands: the frozen window ends at 6.7 eV, below the DFT CBM; on the fitting grid the Wannier conduction bands are off by up to 1.6 eV
decision_points.wrong_choice: Compute electron-doped sigma_xy from the model
decision_points.consequence: sigma_xy -12.6 S/cm reported instead of null

decision_points.fork: Occupation smearing: the zero-temperature limit (the archived run used 1 meV, Eta_Arc in wt.in) versus a large smearing that hides the mesh noise
decision_points.wrong_choice: Smooth the noisy curves with a room-temperature smearing (kT = 25 meV)

graded_fields: sigma_xy_S_per_cm at 2.0e21 and 6.0e21 cm^-3 within 15% of the archived WannierTools output
sigma_xy_sign_changes == 1 (5 meV grid, mu from VBM-1.00 to VBM-0.25 eV)

length_estimate.catalog_units: meshes 48-400 cost 1+1+1+2+3+5+8 = 21 units per Neel direction (42 for both), plus any number of bands / berry_curvature / electron_count requests (1 unit each)
length_estimate.why: Locating the off-path VBM, checking the Wannier model against the DFT eigenvalues, a mesh-convergence study of a noisy Berry-curvature integral under a budget that covers two dense meshes, the p -> mu -> sigma cascade, a magnetic-symmetry analysis that must not trust the archived symmetries.dat, and judging which model outputs (forbidden components, conduction bands) are artefacts.

runtime_dependencies: numpy and scipy (runtime image); no extra layer
notes: Adapted from the candidate design (see the construction README). Graded sigma_xy values are the archived WannierTools output (801 x 801 x 401 mesh, WannSymm-symmetrized Hamiltonian that is not archived) read at the chemical potentials of the requested hole densities; the lab evaluates the archived unsymmetrized Hamiltonian with the same protocol, and its converged 300/400-mesh values lie 3-7% from the archive at the graded points. Targets near the band edge (realistic dopings < 1e21 cm^-3; the design's E-E_F = -0.2 eV) are not graded: they are not converged on any affordable mesh and the archived curve itself has 1-3 meV spikes there. Lucky passes exist: the 150 mesh gives one sign change for some VBM offsets, and the 200 mesh with step occupation passes sigma_xy(2e21); the 100 mesh and the 200 mesh with 0.5-2 meV smearing fail.
